title: Isandro and the Cipher
author: Oscar Nystrom
blurb: Ulyana Nystrom, a hotel concierge who notices everything, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
